messages:
sophia: Quick sync — razorframe on battlecards + launch posts for next week. Need to finalize 3 things: benchmark narrative (short TL;DR + addendum), webinar hooks (2 angles), and inbound routing play (SDR filters + CTA). Who can own which?
raj: I can own benchmark narrative. need the latest perf numbers against the cloud endpoints and our dedicated config. can someone drop the spreadsheet?
nick: dropped: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/benchmarks/razorframe-2026.xlsx — updated throughput/latency for seq_len 256/1024 and cost per 1k tokens.
elaine: taking webinar hooks. proposed two angles: 1) "Predictable inference economics" (dev-focused) 2) "SLA-first deployments for regulated apps" (enterprise).
jamie: SDR routing — recommend 1) web form field: "Are you evaluating infra or full-managed API?" 2) if "infra" -> route to infra AE; if "managed API" -> PLG SDR. also add checkbox for latency sensitivity.
sophia: lovely. raj, can you pull the 3-line TL;DR for benchmark? want an OOH sentence we can put on the blog and banner.
raj: draft TL;DR: "Redwood outperforms major cloud endpoints at 2–3x lower per-token cost for latency-sensitive workloads by combining workload-aware batching and KV caching." feedback?
ellaine: tweak: call out "predictable SLOs" rather than "outperforms"? sales cares about guarantees. maybe: "Redwood delivers predictable SLOs and 2–3x better cost for latency-sensitive inference workloads via batching + KV caching."
nick: +1. also include a short caveat: internal benchmark, configs listed in addendum (link in doc).
sophia: good. for the launch post headline try 2 options: A) "Predictable Inference, Practical Economics" B) "Ship LLM features with SLOs — not surprises"
jamie: A is tighter for social. B is great for webinar landing.
elaine: webinar format: 25 min product demo (dev UX + console), 20 min benchmarks deep-dive, 15 min Q&A with customer panel. need one customer who can speak to migrating from cloud APIs -> Dedicated. anyone?
nick: check with Paige from FinTech pilot — she mentioned ROI signal. I can reach out.
raj: for benchmark addendum: include table for p99 latency, avg tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, config flags (batching window, quantization). I'll prepare CSV.
sophia: routing play: jamie draft the SDR script (2 lines) and I'll add to the flow. jamie can you write the script here?
jamie: SDR script (draft): "Hey — saw you evaluating inference options. Redwood gives predictable SLOs and tooling to control cost. Curious what latency targets you have?" keeps it open.
elaine: we need webinar CTAs: 1) sign up for trial (auto-provisioned sandbox) 2) request dedicated eval 3) get benchmark pack (email capture). prioritize 1 & 3 in landing.
marketing-bot: reminder: webinar landing page deadline in 72h. Eventbrite integration test scheduled for 1745190000.
sophia: assign owners: raj -> benchmark doc + TL;DR; elaine -> webinar hooks + slides; nick -> reach customer for panel + upload assets; jamie -> routing + SDR script + mapping in Outreach. I'll assemble final battlecard and ship a draft to #sales tomorrow morning.
nick: uploaded panel invite template and shared outreach snippet in the folder.
raj: uploading CSV in 20. will note exact hardware used and seed prompt set.
sophia: goal: have 1-pager battlecard + hero social post + webinar landing + inbound routing configured by EOD tomorrow. small, opinionated, and battle-ready.
elaine: ack. quick idea for top bullet on battlecard vs cloud: "Unified runtime across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments — same API, different SLOs." keeps messaging consistent.
jamie: will wire the routing in the next sprint and share the mapping doc.
sophia: thanks team — will post consolidated copy by 5pm PST. :thumbsup:
